    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AgentClientPython
    Class that implement REST calls to python agent
    AgentConfig
    Class used for config the AngentConfig
    AgentController
    REST controller for communicating with a local Python agent service.
    AgentPingResponse
    Represents the response returned by the agent when the ping route is called.
    AgentResponseDTO
    Represents the response returned by the agent when the following routes are called: setActiveUser addLynisRules startLynisScan
    AgentService
    Represents a service running on an agent, corresponding to the service table in the database.
    ApprovedUsers
    Represents a user who has been pre-approved to register to the application, corresponding to the approvedusers table in the database.
    ApprovedUsersRepo
     
    AuthController
    This class implements REST endpoints for user management and authentication
    AuthControllerTest
     
    CorsoConfig
    Class used for manage the cors requests
    DefalutInit
     
    LocalAgentRegistration
    Class used for manage the communication with the python agent.
    Log
    Represents the logs received from the Angular interface or backend, corresponding to the log table in the database.
    LogRepo
    Interface used interact with the table Log
    Lynis
    Represents the details of the Lynis configuration to share with the Python agent.
    LynisRepo
    Interface user for interact with the Lynis table.
    RoleEnum
    Enum is the corrispective of the Rule in the anglular interface.
    RuleDTO
    Represents a single security rule returned by the agent when the getSystemRules route is called.
    Rules
    Represents a security rule monitored and controlled by the Python agent.
    RulesRepo
    Interface used for interact with the repo table.
    Server
    Represents a Python agent stored in the server table.
    ServerController
    REST controller used for manage the interaction between the client angular and the python agent of the docker swarm
    ServerCorvoApplication
    Main class of the server
    ServerCorvoApplicationTests
     
    ServerRepo
    Interface used for interact with the Server table
    ServiceRepo
    Interface used for interact with the Service table.

    Represents the response returned by the agent when the getServiceStatus route is called.
    ServiceStatusResponseDTO.ServiceInfo
    Represents the status information of a single service.
    SystemRulesResponseDTO
    Represents the response returned by the agent when the getSystemRules route is called.
    Tools
    This class contains support functions for manage the hash of the passwords and for the ip validation .
    ToolTests
    Unit tests for methods in the Tools class.
    User
    Represents a user entity stored in the PostgreSQL database.
    UserRepo
    Spring Data JPA repository used to manage User entities.
